description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Compiler class, which is responsible for compiling Smarty template files into PHP code. It includes methods for parsing, compiling, and handling various template tags and constructs, such as {if}, {foreach}, {include}, and custom plugins. The class manages template source processing, plugin management, and the generation of executable PHP code from Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Compiler
classes.description: Template compiling class responsible for transforming Smarty template syntax into executable PHP code, managing parsing, plugin integration, and template tag handling.

methods.name: _compile_file
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty template resource into PHP code, processing template source, handling special blocks, and generating the final PHP output.

methods.name: _compile_tag
methods.description: Parses and compiles individual Smarty template tags into corresponding PHP code snippets.

methods.name: _compile_compiler_tag
methods.description: Handles compilation of custom compiler tags via registered plugins or functions.

methods.name: _compile_block_tag
methods.description: Compiles block-type tags like {section} and {foreach} into PHP loops and logic.

methods.name: _compile_custom_tag
methods.description: Compiles custom functions or plugin tags within templates into PHP code.

methods.name: _compile_registered_object_tag
methods.description: Generates PHP code for object method or property tags registered in Smarty.

methods.name: _compile_insert_tag
methods.description: Compiles {insert} tags that invoke insert handler functions.

methods.name: _compile_include_tag
methods.description: Handles the compilation of {include} tags to include other templates.

methods.name: _compile_include_php_tag
methods.description: Handles the compilation of {include_php} tags for including PHP files.

methods.name: _compile_section_start
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the start of a {section} loop.

methods.name: _compile_foreach_start
methods.description: Creates PHP code for the start of a {foreach} loop.

methods.name: _compile_capture_tag
methods.description: Handles compilation of {capture} tags for output buffering.

methods.name: _compile_if_tag
methods.description: Generates PHP code for {if} and {elseif} conditional tags.

methods.name: _parse_attrs
methods.description: Parses attribute strings within Smarty tags into key-value pairs.

methods.name: _parse_var_props
methods.description: Parses variable tokens into PHP expressions, including handling modifiers and properties.

methods.name: _parse_vars_props
methods.description: Iterates over tokens and parses each variable or property token into PHP code by invoking _parse_var_props.

methods.name: _parse_var_props
methods.description: Converts individual variable tokens, including object calls, string literals, constants, and config or section variables, into appropriate PHP expressions, applying modifiers as needed.

methods.name: _expand_quoted_text
methods.description: Expands quoted strings containing embedded variables into PHP string expressions with variable interpolation.

methods.name: _parse_var
methods.description: Parses a variable expression into corresponding PHP code, handling array indices, object properties, and special variables like $smarty.

methods.name: _parse_parenth_args
methods.description: Parses function call arguments within parentheses into PHP code, resolving variable references and expressions.

methods.name: _parse_conf_var
methods.description: Converts configuration variable expressions into PHP code accessing the internal config array, applying modifiers.

methods.name: _parse_section_prop
methods.description: Transforms section property expressions into PHP code referencing section metadata, with optional modifiers.

methods.name: _parse_modifiers
methods.description: Parses and applies a chain of modifiers to a PHP variable or expression, handling plugin resolution and function call construction.

methods.name: _add_plugin
methods.description: Registers plugin information (functions or class methods) for later invocation within template compilation.

methods.name: _compile_smarty_ref
methods.description: Generates PHP code to reference special Smarty variables such as now, foreach, section, server vars, constants, or config variables based on a reference chain.

methods.name: _compile_plugin_call
methods.description: Returns the PHP function or method name corresponding to a plugin, loading it if necessary, or defaulting to a generic Smarty plugin function name.

methods.name: _load_filters
methods.description: Loads and initializes pre- and post-filters (plugins) registered for Smarty template processing.

methods.name: _quote_replace
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and dollar signs in a string for safe inclusion in PHP code.

methods.name: _syntax_error
methods.description: Triggers a fatal syntax error with detailed message, file, and line number information.

methods.name: _push_cacheable_state
methods.description: Manages cache state transitions for plugins, generating PHP code to reflect cacheability changes.

methods.name: _pop_cacheable_state
methods.description: Handles transition from cacheable to non-cacheable state, generating appropriate PHP code.

methods.name: _push_tag
methods.description: Pushes an opening tag and its line number onto the internal tag stack.

methods.name: _pop_tag
methods.description: Pops a closing tag, ensuring it matches the last opened tag and handling mismatched tags with errors.
